definitions.explanation: Continuing or resuming an activity, process, or event that was underway or had been temporarily interrupted. Often used in formal or official contexts.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}を{続行|ぞっこう}する。
{雨|あめ}が{止|や}んだので、{工事|こうじ}を{続行|ぞっこう}した。
examples.english: Since the rain stopped, they resumed construction.

examples.japanese: {反対|はんたい}の{声|こえ}があったが、{計画|けいかく}は{続行|ぞっこう}されることになった。
examples.english: There were voices of opposition, but it was decided that the plan would be carried on.

notes:
Refers to continuing or resuming an action or process, especially one that has been interrupted or is facing obstacles. More formal than {続|つづ}ける.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試合|しあい}を{続行|ぞっこう}する: to continue a game/match
- {工事|こうじ}を{続行|ぞっこう}する: to continue construction
- {審議|しんぎ}を{続行|ぞっこう}する: to continue deliberation
- {計画|けいかく}を{続行|ぞっこう}する: to carry on with a plan
- {捜査|そうさ}を{続行|ぞっこう}する: to continue an investigation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {継続|けいぞく}: continuation — emphasizes ongoing duration, more general
- {続|つづ}ける: to continue — the everyday verb form, less formal
- {再開|さいかい}: resumption — specifically restarting after a stop
